profile_text.body:
Celestica Inc. is a Toronto-headquartered public company, traded under the ticker CLS, that describes itself as a technology leader with expertise in design, engineering, manufacturing, supply chain and platform solutions. Per its own site, it engineers, designs and manufactures infrastructure for AI, cloud and hybrid cloud, and says it enables critical data center infrastructure while advancing technologies in high-growth markets. The company states that it serves customers through a global network and a team it characterizes as talented, aiming to help customers gain a competitive advantage.

The company's own framing places AI and cloud infrastructure at the center of what it builds, rather than presenting AI as a standalone product line. No specific AI products, MCP servers or lawsuits involving the company are recorded here, and the material available from its site is largely descriptive of its design, engineering and manufacturing role in the AI and cloud supply chain. Its SEC registration is recorded under CIK 0001030894.
